However, Mutalisks counter Siege Tanks and Reapers, so air defense considerations are relevant.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Macro Posture with Heavy Economy and Technology
nodes.trajectory_interpretation: Human trajectories show a stable midgame ground macro posture with heavy economy and technology. The sign is default, indicating no strong preference or harm. Knowledge relations support the viability of Marine and Siege Tank compositions against Zergling and Mutalisk, but caution against relying solely on Siege Tanks due to Mutalisk counters.

applicability_checks: Own technology investment is heavy and production is moderate.
Opponent shows ground posture with Queen cues and heavy economy.
Early game phase with no significant air threat detected.
nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid overcommitting to army before tech/economy foundation is secure; avoid neglecting defense against possible early pressure.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain current development path with safety checks; continue technology and economy development while preserving flexibility.

execution_envelope.fallback_rule: If the preferred candidate is not reachable before the next decision, use a cheaper currently producible trajectory candidate; do not queue a long blocked prerequisite chain while army supply is low.
execution_envelope.feedback_rule: If the bank/low-army deficit persists for two decisions, stop repeating the same plan, re-read the best matching node, and choose a different reachable candidate or producer bottleneck repair.
execution_envelope.resource_conversion_trigger: When the combined bank is at least 750 and army supply is still below 15 after 05:00, prefer a currently executable combat candidate from this pool before optional greed or deeper technology.
execution_envelope.selection_rule: Choose only a currently reachable candidate after checking live producers, prerequisites, resources, supply, and active queues; this is a candidate pool, not an ordered build list.

nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Exit when opponent air presence becomes significant or when own army composition needs to be finalized.
nodes.failure_mode: Resource to army conversion failure or feedback not changing repeated failed posture.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing technology and economy while maintaining scouting and defensive readiness.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent ground posture, heavy economy, moderate production, light or uncertain technology, possible pressure, representative Queen cues.
nodes.own_situation: Own economy moderate, technology heavy, production moderate, expansion light or uncertain, defense light or uncertain, army unknown.
nodes.repair_or_recheck_condition: Recheck if resources are not being converted into army or if repeated failed postures persist; adjust production or tech priorities accordingly.
